title: Henselization and strict henselization of a valuation ring are weakly unramified extensions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The statement says that for a valuation ring the inclusions of its henselization and of its strict henselization are extensions of valuation rings inducing bijections on value groups, that is, they are weakly unramified (statement lines 37534-37543). The proof writes the henselization as a filtered colimit of localizations of etale algebras at primes over the maximal ideal, applies the statement about etale extensions of valuation rings to each term to get a valuation ring with the same value group, and then uses the statement about filtered colimits of valuation rings to conclude for the henselization; the strict henselization is treated by the same argument with the corresponding description, and the composite inclusion follows from the identification of the strict henselization of the henselization (proof lines 37545-37565). The colimit presentation and the two transfer statements are what make the argument uniform for both inclusions. The counted span refers four times, once to a result of this chapter and three times to results of other chapters, all carried as navigation stubs.
